identity.name: James Black
identity.summary: New Orleans drummer and composer who played modern jazz with Ellis Marsalis, Cannonball Adderley and Horace Silver, and R&B and funk at home.

contribution.description: A New Orleans modern-jazz drummer and composer ("Monkey Puzzle", "Dee Wee") who also played the drums on Eddie Bo's funk single "Hook and Sling"; Zigaboo Modeliste names him among the drummers he learned from.

beatbreaker.group: New Orleans R&B and funk drummers
